New coverage added for TestSettings (default/update/clamp), TestCreateProduct (variant default, next order index, label), TestEditOrder (recomputes total, restores+re-decrements stock with net delta, preserves document_no, swaps client/status, remove-line path, 400 on empty lines, 404 on unknown id), TestDashboardLowStock (field presence + reacts to threshold change), TestMonthlyReports (default month, specific month filter, totals/per_collaborator/products shape, 2001-01 empty-month). Regression: baseline 18 products + original 21 auth/products/collaborators/clients/orders/dashboard tests still pass. Frontend (mobile 390x844): login OK, dashboard KPIs render, 'Rapoarte lunare' button navigates to /rapoarte with month chips, gear opens threshold modal (threshold-input + save-threshold-button) and PUT persists, Produse tab 'Adauga produs' creates custom product via UI and new item appears in list, Comenzi tab orders-search-input filters rows (bogus search -> 0 rows, clear -> rows restored), collaborator sheet opens with Stoc/Clienti tabs - Clienti exposes client-search-input (singular) and Stoc tab renders low-{productId} warning icons (9 icons at threshold=12), order detail exposes edit-order-button which navigates to /comanda-noua?editId=<id> and renders 'EDITEAZA COMANDA' prefilled with collaborator/client/quantities/total. No red screens, no console errors, no deprecated expo packages detected.
action_items: No code fixes required. All 5 new features (edit order, add custom product, low-stock settings, dashboard low_stock, monthly reports) work exactly as specified for both API and UI.
Optional: there is no DELETE /api/products endpoint, so custom products created during tests remain in the DB (harmless). Consider adding one for admin cleanup if desired.
Optional: the client-search testID is 'client-search-input' (singular). If main agent intended 'clients-search-input' plural per PRD wording, keep in mind for any future shared docs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py ~605 lines - still manageable but approaching the point where splitting into routers (auth/products/collaborators/clients/orders/settings/reports) would help.

PUT /api/orders/{order_id}: the stock restore+re-decrement sequence is correct and preserves document_no/created_at; collaborator_id is intentionally NOT editable (per spec). The two-step update (stock write + order write) is not transactional - low risk for single-tenant app but worth noting.

monthly_report groups by date substring YYYY-MM; dates are stored as ISO UTC strings so a user in a non-UTC timezone could see edge-of-month orders in the 'wrong' month. Acceptable for Romania (UTC+2/+3) but document for the operator.

Dashboard low_stock lists ALL non-negative items with qty<=threshold - including items with qty=0 that may never have been seeded for a given collaborator. Current behavior matches the spec. If threshold is set very high (e.g. 100) the list can get long; consider capping/returning count-only when > N.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend suite with: `cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/test_backend_api.py -v -n 0 --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. The suite shares state across classes via a module-level `state` dict so always use `-n 0` (pytest.ini otherwise forces `-n 2 --dist loadscope`). Custom products created by TestCreateProduct cannot be deleted (no endpoint) and persist in DB - the regression test asserts baseline 18 are a *subset*, not equality. UI selectors to remember: login-password-input, login-submit-button, kpi-pending/stock/..., open-settings, threshold-input, save-threshold-button, open-reports, month-<YYYY-MM>, add-product-button, product-<category|variant|size|price>-input, save-product-button, orders-search-input, order-row-<DZL....>, edit-order-button, tab-Stoc, tab-Clienti, client-search-input (singular!), low-<productId>, adjust-<productId>. Note login button text is 'INTRA IN CONT' (not 'Autentificare' which is the section header).
